defs.def: a date that is an exact number of years after the date of an important or special event 周年纪念日

ex.s: Anniversaries and birthdays carry even more weight in long-distance friendships.
ex.t: 虽然技术可能使日常交流成为可能，但在特殊日子付出额外的努力会有很大帮助。

ex.s: This year, we are celebrating our 50th anniversary.
ex.t: 今年，我们要庆祝我们的50周年纪念日。

ex.s: The event celebrate its 22nd anniversary with a great show of the very best of gardening,  making it one of the most popular events in gardening.
ex.t: 该活动以一场展示最佳园艺的盛大演出庆祝其22周年，使之成为最受欢迎的园艺活动之一。

ex.s: But as the 200th anniversary of his birth approaches, it is possible — and important for our own culture—to understand how he made himself a lasting one.
ex.t: 但随着他诞辰200周年临近，去理解他如何让自己成为不朽作家，不仅是可能的，也对我们自身的文化十分重要。

ex.s: It marked the 75th anniversary of the theater.
ex.t: 它标志着剧院75周年纪念。

ex.s: Dear friends, Thank you for coming together to celebrate the first anniversary of Tech-Hub Business Park.
ex.t: 亲爱的朋友们，感谢你们齐聚一堂，庆祝Tech-Hub Business Park成立一周年。

ex.s: In 2017, representatives from Peking University, Tsinghua University, Nankai University and Yunnan Normal University gathered to commemorate the 80th anniversary of its founding.
ex.t: 2017年，来自北京大学、清华大学、南开大学和云南师范大学的代表齐聚一堂，纪念其成立80周年。

ex.s: You can use the cards for any special occasion: weddings, births, anniversaries, Christmas, etc.
ex.t: 您可以在任何特殊场合使用这些卡片：婚礼、出生、纪念日、圣诞节等。

ex.s: On the third anniversary of her mother's death, Anna gave a speech, asking people of all ages to remember their mothers by words, gifts and acts of affection.
ex.t: 在她母亲去世三周年之际，安娜发表了一篇演讲，要求所有年龄段的人用言语、礼物和爱的行为来纪念他们的母亲。
